title: A characterization of virtually cyclic outer automorphism groups of right-angled Coxeter groups
summary: Existing research gives conditions for when the outer automorphism group of a graph product of primary cyclic groups $W_Γ$ is finite, virtually abelian, or large. We seek to prove a set of conditions for when this outer automorphism group is virtually cyclic. To this end, we study the finite index subgroup $\text{Out}^0(W_Γ)$, which is generated by specific partial conjugations.
